title: upgrade-manifest
description: What a signed agent release contains (docs/spec/07-upgrade-channel.md "Package format"). The build pipeline writes it and has its exact bytes signed by the release key in the KMS; the agent checks that signature against the public key compiled into it before it reads anything else. product stops a signature made for something else from being taken as an agent release.

version.description: The version this release installs. Always higher than any earlier release: a rollback ships older code under a higher number.

minimumVersion.description: The oldest installed version this release may upgrade.
